executionStateAtFreeze: No V4 end-to-end comparison was executed before this protocol file was saved. The hash verifies bytes and local chronology; this is not an external preregistration.
purpose: Exploratory equal end-to-end wall-budget challenge of direct event-date search, permutation search, raw MILP and audited-incumbent safe-presolve composite. Do not infer competition win probability or population savings.

definition.independence: Each main case uses a unique seed. No order-list nesting or reuse across the 48 cases. This does not make synthetic configurations a representative population sample.

generator.selection: Full factorial 3 mechanisms × 2 capacity profiles × 3 scales, one fixed unique new seed per cell, 41001 through 41018. No case replacement or outcome-based seed selection.

budget.clock: Parent performance.now(), from before fork/spawn through received audited result. Includes child process startup, dynamic imports, initial baselines, WASM initialization, model construction, preprocessing, solution audit and IPC delivery. Parent enforces deadline via SIGKILL. OS kill/exit delivery overhead is separately recorded.
budget.solverSeconds: Remaining child seconds are merely an advisory GLPK limit. Parent hard wall is authoritative; synchronous WASM may be killed.
budget.cpuAllocation: One method child at a time; methods rotate in a Latin order for each case; no simultaneous benchmark methods. Host load may vary.
budget.checkpoints: Complete engine-audited and independently cost/constraint-audited schedules may be checkpointed by IPC before the hard deadline. Kill retains only checkpoints received within deadline, never a proof from a killed solve.

methodDefinitions.permutation: Four greedy initial policies, followed by old solveStrongSearch permutation relocate/swap in small batches until deadline. Earliest decoder unchanged; each batch includes its actual runtime.
methodDefinitions.eventSearch: Four greedy initial policies followed by direct (pickup, unloading-start, return) event-domain relocation and bounded randomized destroy/repair. All daily truck, unloading, staging constraints checked; complete schedules are audited before checkpoint.
methodDefinitions.rawMILP: Cold solveOptimized with presolveV4=false; no heuristic fallback or precomputed incumbent.
methodDefinitions.presolveMILP: Composite: four greedy initial policies plus one small permutation batch supply audited feasible cutoff/checkpoint; cold solveOptimized with presolveV4=true and those initial policies. No claim of GLPK MIP warm start. A lower-bound certificate is separately labeled as analytic optimality; cutoff fallback stays heuristic.

reporting.retain: Every frozen cell, all failures, no incumbents, zero denominators, ties and losses stay in raw data. Partial schedules have null fees and never count as feasible.
reporting.comparison: Report feasibility, audited paired costs against each comparator, end-to-end completion and retained incumbent source. Compare rawMILP and presolveMILP separately; composite fallback is not GLPK success.
reporting.inference: Exploratory synthetic stress cells, not representative orders or business population samples. No confidence interval, empirical customer savings, or first-place promise.
reporting.optimality: Proven optimal counts require an audited complete solution and proof delivered before the deadline. Killed checkpoint is heuristic/feasible_incumbent_only.
reporting.feeBase: Incremental modeled fees subtract fixed pre-horizon accrued-fee base, not verified actual payment or accounting sunk cost.

dataBoundary: Public official tariffs and disclosed fee interpretations only; all orders, capacities and mechanism mixtures synthetic. No private TOS, gate histories, internal plans or real customer records.
